title: Doggerland
description: Doggerland follows Musa Nasir, an illegal immigrant and refugee, scraping an existence working at an exploitative UK car wash. Homeless, underpaid, Musa is determined to turn his life around and make it in the UK. In an attempt to escape his grim reality, he makes a drastic decision and takes on an underground driving job.
editors: Rachel Durance Sarah must make a journey from Belfast to Liverpool to avoid a life she does not want. A journey that is against the law. Under cover of darkness and without the knowledge of her parents
